image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming in an underwater environment. The fish displays characteristic red and white vertical stripes on its body and large, fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays. The dorsal spines are visible fanning out above the head. The background consists of blurred coral reef structures in reddish and brownish tones.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Laterally compressed body with moderately sized proportions.
